mapper.select: SELECT id, biz_type, biz_id, plan_time, content, remind_before, status, owner, organization_id, create_user, update_user, create_time, update_time FROM crm_follow_plan WHERE biz_type = #{bizType} AND biz_id = #{bizId} ORDER BY plan_time ASC

SELECT id, biz_type, biz_id, plan_time, content, remind_before, status, owner, organization_id, create_user, update_user, create_time, update_time FROM crm_follow_plan WHERE owner = #{owner} AND organization_id = #{organizationId} AND status = 'pending' ORDER BY plan_time ASC
